main.description: Ephemeral player state for cross-device sync. Singleton record (rkey: self), overwritten via putRecord.

acceptedTermsAt.description: ISO datetime the player most recently accepted the Terms of Service / Privacy Policy.

acceptedTermsVersion.description: The highest Terms of Service / Privacy Policy version this player has accepted (see src/utils/termsVersion.js TERMS_VERSION). Drives the first-run acceptance gate; when this is below the current TERMS_VERSION the user is re-prompted to accept.

activeBlocksIntentionDaily.description: Target active blocks per day (decimal string, e.g. '6')

activityIntentionConsuming7d.description: Deprecated: use activityIntentionTotal7d. Target weekly consuming count.

activityIntentionCreating7d.description: Deprecated: use activityIntentionTotal7d. Target weekly creating count.

activityIntentionTotal7d.description: Target total weekly activity count, sum of all actions (decimal string, e.g. '500')

activityIntentionX.description: Activity style intention X position as grid percentage (0-100, consuming axis)

activityIntentionY.description: Activity style intention Y position as grid percentage (0-100, creating axis)

appMode.description: Chosen app experience: 'story' (full immersive) or 'open' (simpler). Authoritative cross-device value for the mode picked during onboarding.

completedChapters.description: Object mapping completed story/onboarding chapter ids (e.g. 'welcome') to the ISO datetime they were completed. Drives whether the onboarding/changelog overlays are shown.

currentLight.description: Current light charge in Wh (decimal string, e.g. '280.0')

equipped.description: Equipment slots: object mapping slotId (hands, backpack, camp) to arrays of equipped item ID strings

inventoryMigrationV2.description: Whether the v2 inventory/equipment migration has been applied for this player.

inventoryMigrationV3.description: Whether the v3 inventory/equipment migration (power-station id remap) has been applied for this player.

lastSessionStart.description: When the current session started (for multi-device awareness)

lightDrainActive.description: Whether light drain was active when state was saved

longestRestMinutes.description: Rest ledger high-water-mark: the longest rest stretch ever (time away from the forest between walks) in minutes, as a decimal string. Monotonic — only ever increases. Everything else the rest ledger shows is computed on read from the walk records; this is the one durable figure.

onboardingGoals.description: Comma-joined list of goal ids the player selected during onboarding (e.g. 'offline-more,reply-more'). Stored as a string to avoid depending on array support.

slotCapacity.description: Slot capacity overrides: object mapping slotId to integer capacity (for upgrades). Slots not listed use default capacity.

starterItemsGranted.description: Whether the player has received their starter items

triggerSource.description: What caused this state snapshot (visibility_hidden, session_end, stamina_depleted, manual)

tutorialCompletedAt.description: When the player completed (or skipped) the interactive tutorial. Presence of this field means the tutorial is done; absence means it has not been completed.

updatedAt.description: When this state snapshot was taken
